name: 22361-audiotranscribe-whisperlargev3-1gpu
model: openai/whisper-large-v3, fp16. Public and ungated, ~3 GiB of weights.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap; 1600 requests are measured.
workload: 511 earnings-call audio clips from D4nt3/esb-datasets-earnings22-validation-tiny-filtered (split `validation`), one clip per request, posted to POST /v1/audio/transcriptions. Every clip is under 30 s. One turn, and nothing is sent beyond the file and the model name -- no language and no response format, so the endpoint's own defaults apply. The audio column is mapped and the rest ignored, so the reference transcript is carried but never sent.
purpose: A speech-to-text service transcribing short earnings-call clips for 32 concurrent callers on a single GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block would be dropped. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits
# `--key`, `false` emits nothing. Environment variables cannot live here.

model-path: openai/whisper-large-v3
tp-size: 1
disable-radix-cache: true

# Chunked prefill OFF is a correctness requirement here, not tuning: a request must be
# admitted as one unit, and the auto-selected 8192 truncates the sixth queued request below
# that. Any value <= 0 maps to "off", after which stock `max_prefill_tokens` governs.
chunked-prefill-size: -1
